mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates on future corporate cash flows and increasing equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive during periods of declining FEDFUNDS (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 5.0% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which triggers a shift in investor expectations toward future monetary policy accommodation, boosting equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal fails to outperform baseline in 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in aggregate demand, which increases the likelihood of imminent monetary policy intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day SPX returns in more than 50% of instances, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05 in interaction term regression).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 (index 2017=100) over two consecutive months signals a contraction in real economic output, which triggers risk-off sentiment and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05), or the signal generates positive returns in more than 55% of triggered cases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with rising housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong aggregate demand, which raises expectations of future inflation and tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint rise in RSAFS and HOUST fails to produce negative 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a tightening cycle in a weakening economy, increasing the risk of recession and triggering equity market sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and INDPRO declines, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% indicates a labor market deterioration, which increases the probability of central bank intervention, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real GDP (GDPC1) in the most recent quarter, combined with a drop in industrial production (INDPRO), signals a deepening economic contraction, which increases the likelihood of aggressive fiscal or monetary stimulus, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when GDPC1 declines >1.0% qoq and INDPRO falls, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.
